title: P3 service/control and monitor/script_run: result
description: The result of the two built-in write tools returns to the model only as closed fields: the result code, the service state after reconciliation, the service_grant number or approval_id. The core stores the script output separately as a task journal file marked as untrusted text. The model sees a permission refusal and a stop as the same short forbidden; the needs field names the initiator permission (PRM-8).

approval_id.description: Approval number, if the call went through a card.

items.description: Group capability: a string of the form <form>:<name> from capabilities.yaml, without an asterisk, for example task:ops.investigate.v1, service.control:nginx, admin:people.
